title: The exceptional linguistic density of Vanuatu: Introduction to the volume
notes: Consulted directly on 23 November 2026: the whole volume (270-page PDF; the text layer is in a shifted font encoding and was decoded for searching). The introduction and ten chapters are on morphosyntax, numerals, space systems, dialect documentation and oral narratives (Pearce on Unua, Budd on Bierebo, Touati on Sakao, Franjieh on North Ambrym, Garde on Sa numerals, François on Torres-Banks space systems, Schneider & Gray on Suru Kavian, Jauncey on Tamambo, Thieberger on Erromango). No table of sound correspondences and no phoneme inventory: Garde's chapter mentions in passing Raga-Sa correspondences in the numerals, an f kept only in some numerals and in four northern villages, and [t] palatalised to [c] before high vowels in all Sa dialects but that of Baie Martelli; Budd's Table 3 lists Bierebo reflexes of POc verbs. Cited here for the volume, whose chapters are not otherwise entered.
